name: token-safety-screen
description: Pre-buy safety screen for any crypto token — fuses web scam/rugpull reports (Exa), live X/Twitter chatter for honeypot/rug signals (SELAT Twitter advanced_search), and smart-money positioning (Nansen holdings) into one verdict brief, paid per call across two rails (Circle Gateway nanopayment + MPP on Tempo) via selat-pay (USDC via Circle Gateway). Answers 'is this token a trap?' — a different question from price/market briefs.

token.description: Token symbol or name to screen (no $). Used in the Exa scam-report query and the X chatter search (used as ${token}).

network.description: Chain/network name for the Nansen smart-money holdings query (used as ${network}). Named 'network' to avoid colliding with the selat CLI's reserved --chain settlement flag.

steps.label: scam/rugpull web reports — Exa search (MPP on Tempo)
live X chatter — SELAT advanced_search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
smart-money positioning — Nansen holdings (MPP on Tempo)
